BR-24				BRAKE SYSTEM — Front Brake

3.	REMOVE BRAKE HOSE BRACKET
	Remove the two bolts and remove the bracket.

BR1175

4.	REMOVE CYLINDER FROM TORQUE PLATE
	(a)	Remove the installation bolt from the torque plate.

BR1176

	(b)	Remove the brake cylinder and suspend it so the hose
		is not stretched.
	HINT: Do not disconnect the brake hose.

BR1177

5.	REMOVE FOLLOWING PARTS
	(a)	Two anti-squeal springs
	(b)	Two brake pads
	(c)	Four anti-squeal shims
	(d)	Two pad support plates

6.	CHECK ROTOR DISC THICKNESS
	(See step 2 on page BR-28)

7.	CHECK ROTOR DISC RUNOUT
	(See step 3 on page BR-28)

BR1178

8.	INSTALL TWO PAD SUPPORT PLATES
	Install the two pad support plates to the torque plate.

BR1179
